# Rashik Lab — Q&A knowledge archive

This public archive contains four source-traceable Q&A entries attributed in their supplied PDFs to G. K. M. Jarif Ur Rahim. The entries describe his views, a proposed philosophical framework, a conceptual AI-safety proposal, and an initiative described by the source PDFs; they are not an independent fact-check. Speculative or owner-reported claims are labelled as such.
